subject: BrightGrowth webinar promo credit request - approval needed
messages:
From: Emma Lopez <emma@brightgrowth.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Promo credits for July 23 webinar - BrightGrowth x Redwood

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for supporting the co-hosted webinar on July 23. We had a quick sponsor ask that I wanted to run past you — would Redwood be able to provide promo credits for registrants as a post-webinar follow-up?

Details:
- Quantity: 250 credits (one-time promo code per registrant)
- Value: $5 equivalent credit per code (redeemable on Redwood Hosted API usage)
- Purpose: Drive first-run evaluation and capture conversion metrics tied to the webinar campaign
- Expiration: 30 days from issuance

Attached is a short sponsor one-pager and our registrant list format for reference. If you can approve, we’ll distribute the codes in our follow-up email and track redemptions. If you prefer to limit to qualifying accounts only, we can filter by company size/role on our side — let me know the criteria.

Appreciate a quick thumbs up if this is feasible.

Best,
Emma
Emma Lopez
Partnerships, BrightGrowth
attachments: webinar-sponsor-onepager.pdf, registrant_template.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Lopez <emma@brightgrowth.co>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 12:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Promo credits for July 23 webinar - BrightGrowth x Redwood

Rishi / Naomi — looping you in for approval and ops.

Emma, thanks for the details. This is something we do occasionally for partner-led webinars. Quick thoughts:
- 250 x $5 = $1,250 list exposure; we can charge to the marketing partnership budget (code: PART-Q3-2025).
- I want to make sure we track redemption back to the BrightGrowth campaign in HubSpot. Naomi — can you create a promo code campaign and map redemptions to the HubSpot campaign id?
- Rishi — do we need additional guardrails on applicability (e.g., block redemptions from internal domains, limit to first-time customers only)?

If you both are OK, I can send an approval note and deliver the CSV of codes. Proposed expiration 30 days from issuance and one-code-per-account.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Promo credits for July 23 webinar - BrightGrowth x Redwood

Thanks Marissa — I’m fine with the ask. A couple of guardrails I’d like to include:
- Redemption restricted to company domains not on our blocklist; no internal/test emails.
- First-time billable accounts only (so trial-only account duplicates don’t stack).
- Rate limit: one redemption per billing profile.

Naomi — if you can generate the 250 codes and upload them to the HubSpot campaign, please tag with deal_id RG-2025-447 and the budget code PART-Q3-2025. Also include an attribution field so we can measure MQL -> SQL movement from the webinar.

If Ops confirms rules above, approve from my side.

—Rishi
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Lopez <emma@brightgrowth.co>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 16:01:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Promo credits for July 23 webinar - BrightGrowth x Redwood

Got it — will generate the codes and create the HubSpot campaign entry today. Plan:
- Generate 300 codes (250 active + 50 spare) in promo_codes_20250712.csv.
- Promo metadata: expiry = 30 days after issuance; usage_limit = 1 per billing profile; eligibility = first_paid_only; blocklist = internal@redwood.com, qa@redwood.com (we’ll maintain the blocklist).
- Attachments: I’ll upload the CSV to Drive and paste the download link in the campaign.

Emma: once we finalize distribution timing, I’ll share the CSV (stub attached here). Please confirm you’ll only send to registrants and include the following redemption instructions in your follow-up email: how to apply promo, expiration, and contact for support.

Naomi Feldman

Emma — approved.

Summary / next steps:
- Approval: Redwood to provide up to 250 promo credits (value $5 each). Budget charged to PART-Q3-2025; deal_id RG-2025-447.
- Rules: one-code-per-billing-profile; first-paid-only eligibility; blocked internal/test domains. Expiration = 30 days from issuance.
- Naomi will generate promo_codes_20250712.csv and upload to Drive; she’s also creating the HubSpot campaign and will tag redemptions.
- Emma, please confirm distribution date and that you’ll only send to registrants (no public codes). Once you confirm, Naomi will mark the codes live and share the Drive link.

Emma — thanks for the partnership. Looking forward to the post-webinar metrics.

Best,
